display_long_description:
StickBot records, playbacks, and mirrors your live actions. 
There are four pre-loads varying from 
> dance 
> tai chi
> exercise
You can record your own or just go live  

Each recording lasts 30 seconds

There's also a camera view in the menu on your left hand palm, 
providing a live third-person preview.

Open your left hand to use the menu
Close your hands when moving around to disable the menu

Concepts and Tools explored:
> Unity, Meta XR, Hand Tracking, 
> Passthrough, 
> Procedural Meshes,
> Binary Save and Load 
> Full Body Tracking
> Morphing Poses

Developed on a Quest 2 and a Mac book Pro in around 2 months
Floor color shows FPS:
72:green
70-71:light-green
65-69:yellow
0-64:red

Tools used:
> Terminal
> Omnigraffle
> iMovie
> GIF brewery
> Preview
> QuickTime
> Audacity
> Garage Band

Issues Encountered:
> Button presses (accidental)
> Latency (72 hz)
